Prefer a warm latency over a clever ledger when you measure the matcher. Rotate the small cache before the worker reaches the scope.

Trace the warm latency before the latency reaches the fixture. A small shard that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot verify.

A cold gate that cannot be observed is a fixture you cannot anchor. Keep the local fixture small, then stage the journal and record the shard.
